title: Acceptance Is Not Repeat Operation
summary: A four-stage map separating validation, receiving-system acceptance, recurring operation, and comparable outcome while preserving the Phase 66 no-transfer rule.
map_question: What evidence is required after implementation before a named file can support an accepted, repeated, or comparable operating claim?
interpretation_boundary: The four nodes are distinct evidence questions, not a universal linear workflow. A file can enter at different points, and no node automatically proves the next one.

nodes.label: Named validation
nodes.note: Inspection, test, compliance, qualification, exception, correction, and retest must match the named scope.

nodes.label: Receiving-system acceptance
nodes.note: A named authority or customer accepts the defined asset, service, product, occupancy, cutover, or operating condition.

nodes.label: Compatible recurring operation
nodes.note: Multiple observations preserve entity, scope, period, definition, method, denominator, and exceptions.

nodes.label: Comparable outcome
nodes.note: A repeated series supports only a bounded outcome with a stable measure, denominator, acceptance state, and attribution boundary.

nodes.label: No automatic evidence transfer
nodes.note: Adjacent entities, plans, authority, construction, one-time events, and context records do not flow forward or sideways.

links.note: A successful test may be necessary but does not itself establish acceptance.
One accepted event does not establish recurring operation.
Repeated activity still needs a stable outcome definition, denominator, and attribution boundary.
The no-transfer rule prevents context and upstream records from becoming outcome evidence.

what_this_map_supports: Validation, acceptance, recurring operation, and comparable outcome can be reviewed as separate downstream questions.
Same-entity identity, receiving-system authority, compatible repetition, and stable denominators are distinct evidence requirements.
A held or context record can guide the next search without changing a matrix cell.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish readiness, maturity, value, risk, safety, performance, or probability for any file.
It does not rank or compare unlike named systems.
It does not convert a test, acceptance event, or repeated activity into an operating outcome.
next_records_needed: Same-entity validation results with exceptions, corrections, and retests.
Named receiving-system or customer acceptance records.
Compatible repeat-operation and outcome series with stable identity, method, period, and denominator.
